description: This source file defines the Java class `BackgroundPickers`, which manages a collection of UI components for selecting background images in an Android application. It includes methods for generating the pickers, retrieving selected resources, clearing selections, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: BackgroundPickers
classes.description: Manages a collection of background image pickers within a container view, handles creation, retrieval, and user interaction for selecting backgrounds.

methods.name: generatePickers
methods.description: Creates and adds a specified number of background picker UI elements into the container.

methods.name: getRes
methods.description: Returns the resource ID of the selected background at a specific position.

methods.name: getRes
methods.description: Returns all background resource IDs currently managed by the pickers.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all picker views and clears internal data structures.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of current pickers.
